source_caption:
Widow's Bay needs to be at the absolute top of your watchlist.

It is a hilarious anxiety inducing watch from beginning to end that spirals out of control from the first second. It is equal parts Parks and Recreation workplace humor and absolute nightmare-fuel horror. Don't sleep on this one.

I am in love with the cast, the performances are incredible and I've genuinely fallen in love with this show. I may just be obsessed with it. 

Are you watching Widows Bay on @appletv ?! Let me know what you think!
